question: The average weight of a family of five members whose weights are 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 75 kg and 37 kg is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed average weight be 50 kg.

Deviations from 50 kg: −10, −1, +6, +25, −13.

Net deviation = (−10 − 1 + 6 + 25 − 13) = +7.

Average deviation = +7 ÷ 5 = +1.4 kg.

Actual average = 50 + 1.4 = 51.4 kg.

**∴ The correct answer is 51.4 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Weights of 5 family members = 40 kg, 49 kg, 56 kg, 75 kg, 37 kg

Total number of members (n) = 5

 
•

 Avg = 51.4 kg

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations ÷ Total number of observations

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of weights = 40 + 49 + 56 + 75 + 37

⇒ Sum of weights = 257 kg

⇒ Average = 257 ÷ 5

⇒ Average = 51.4 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 51.4 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average (Mean)

The average is the central or typical value in a discrete set of data. It is calculated algebraically as: Average = Sum of Values ÷ Number of Values.

Deviation Method

An assumed mean is selected to simplify calculations. Actual Average = Assumed Average + (Net Deviation ÷ Number of Observations).

Combined / Weighted Average

Used when merging different groups with varying counts. Formula: Combined Average = (A₁n₁ + A₂n₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
